title: Logic Hijacking of RAG: Single-Document Poisoning via Local Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2610.34829v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Single-document corpus poisoning under black-box access poses a severe threat to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). However, existing attacks predominantly rely on explicit factual refutations or imperative instruction overrides. Modern aligned LLMs often arbitrate such conflicts conservatively, rejecting overt contradictions in favor of parametric memory or clean retrieved context while triggering input guardrails. We propose MONOLOGUE, a single-document poisoning framework based on Logic Hijacking without explicit refutation. Rather than disputing the ground truth, our method concedes it as an authoritative historical baseline before introducing the update, weaving a grounded record-correction narrative (e.g., dated institutional reattributions) that presents the counterfactual target as the most recent update. translated_title: RAG的逻辑劫持：基于局部优化的单文档投毒
translated_abstract: 在黑盒访问条件下，单文档语料库投毒对检索增强生成（RAG）构成了严重威胁。然而，现有的攻击方法主要依赖于显式的事实反驳或指令性覆盖。现代对齐的大语言模型在仲裁此类冲突时往往采取保守策略，会拒绝明显的矛盾内容，转而偏向参数化记忆或干净的检索上下文，同时触发输入防护机制。我们提出了MONOLOGUE，一个基于“逻辑劫持”且无需显式反驳的单文档投毒框架。该方法并不质疑真实标准（ground truth），而是先将其承认为权威的历史基线，然后再引入更新，编织出一个有据可查的记录更正叙事（例如带日期的机构重新归属），从而将反事实目标呈现为最新的更新。为避免可疑的实时写入，攻击载荷完全通过离线的局部多维门控优化进行精炼。
tldr: 该论文提出MONOLOGUE框架，通过“逻辑劫持”策略——先承认事实为历史基线、再以离线局部多维门控优化生成的记录更正叙事呈现反事实目标——实现了无需显式反驳的单文档RAG语料投毒攻击。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes MONOLOGUE, a single-document RAG corpus poisoning framework that hijacks logic by conceding the ground truth as a historical baseline and weaving grounded record-correction narratives refined offline via local multi-dimensional gated optimization, enabling poisoning without explicit refutation.
